svg.text: FIGURE 3.4: DOCUMENT PROCESSING AND CONTEXT INJECTION WORKFLOW IN OMNIAI

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Grounded Document Ingestion, Semantic Chunking, Prompt Synthesis, and Context Augmentation Pipeline

g.text: End-user selects a document from the local device and uploads it via the OmniAI chat attachment interface.

Extracted document text is divided into overlapping blocks along natural paragraph boundaries (
) to preserve semantic coherence.
Ranks and extracts top relevant chunks based on
query term frequency or uniform document sampling.
End-user enters a prompt or domain query related
to the attached document in the chat interface.
Synthesizes the user query and extracted text into a strictly bounded prompt with anti-hallucination constraints:
You are analyzing the uploaded document: "{document_filename}".
{Extracted Top-Chunks Context Text up to 7,000 characters}
CRITICAL INSTRUCTIONS: Answer using ONLY document facts. Never hallucinate.
The selected AI model reasons over the combined context and synthesizes an answer anchored in document evidence:
The assistant response is rendered in the OmniAI chat UI with Markdown formatting, document tags, and latency metrics.
"Current implementation supports text extraction from PDF, TXT and Markdown files.
OCR for scanned image-only PDFs is planned for future development."
• Vector database retrieval (e.g. Pinecone/Chroma) and OCR engines (e.g. Tesseract) are intentionally omitted
from current scope to ensure zero-cost execution and lightweight serverless operation on free tiers.
